description: 使用：放置战旗 在目标地点创造一面旗帜。战旗立起后作用范围内的小兵将免疫伤害。战旗持续%duration%秒。 可以被摧毁。近战英雄对战旗造成2倍伤害。
active: Place Banner：Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds. Can be destroyed. Melee hero attacks deal 2x damage to the banner.

name: 狂石包
description: 收集后可制作新的中立物品。

name: 奶酪块
description: 使用：可口 倒是吃啊！
active: Scrumptious：Try me!

name: 树之祭祀（共享）
description: 使用：吞食 吃掉一棵树，获得%health_regen%点/秒生命恢复，持续%buff_duration%秒。食用铁树枝干种下的小树后恢复时间加倍。 距离：%abilitycastrange%
active: Devour：Consumes a target tree to gain 3.5 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration. Tree Range: 165

name: 血腥榴弹
description: 主动：投掷榴弹 向目标区域投掷一枚榴弹。区域内敌人被击中时受到%impact_damage%点伤害，减速%movespeed_slow%%%并且每%tick_rate%秒受到%damage_over_time%点伤害，持续%debuff_duration%秒。
active: Throw Grenade：Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.

name: 岗哨守卫
description: 使用：放置 放置隐形的岗哨守卫来为附近%true_sight_range%范围的区域提供真实视域。可以看到隐形的敌方单位和守卫。 持续%duration_minutes_tooltip%分钟。 本身不提供视野。 按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用，将1个守卫转移到他的物品栏中。
active: Plant：Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a 1050 radius. Lasts 7 minutes. Does not grant ground vision. Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

name: 动物信使
description: Animal Courier

name: 诡计之雾
description: 使用：潜行 施法者和附近%application_radius%范围内的友方玩家控制单位在%duration%秒内获得隐身效果和%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。他们在小地图上的图标也会消失。 只要施法者还在潜行状态下，任意友军进入他身边%secondary_application_radius%范围内也会获得加成效果。每个诡计之雾只能对一名友军施加一次效果。 发动攻击，或靠近敌方英雄或防御塔%visibility_radius%距离后将打破隐身效果。 潜行的隐身效果不受真实视域影响。 诡计之雾在背包中可以直接使用，换至主物品栏时没有冷却时间。
active: Disguise：Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled units in a 1200 radius invisible, and grants 15% bonus movement speed for 45 seconds. While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within 300 range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies. Attacking or moving within 1025 range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility. Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight. Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.

name: 铁树枝干
description: 主动：种树 对地面施放，种下一棵快乐的小树，持续%tree_duration%秒。
active: Plant Tree：Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

name: 净化药水
description: 使用：回魔 向目标提供%mana_regen%点/秒魔法恢复，持续%buff_duration%秒。 受到敌方英雄或肉山攻击时效果会被驱散。
active: Replenish：Grants 6 mana regeneration to the target for 25 seconds. If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

name: 仙灵之火
description: 使用：吞服 立刻回复%hp_restore%点生命值。
active: Imbue：Instantly restores 85 health.

name: 魔法芒果
description: 使用：吞食芒果 立刻回复%replenish_amount%点魔法。
active: Eat Mango：Instantly restores 100 mana.

name: 知识之书
description: 使用：启迪 直接获得%xp_bonus%点经验值，而且己方在前两本书后每消耗一本知识之书，将额外获得%xp_per_use%点经验。 己方已使用本数：%customval_team_tomes_used%
active: Enlighten：Grants you 750 experience plus 150 per tome consumed by your team after the first two.

name: 显影之尘
description: 使用：现形 在施法者站立位置的%radius%范围内创造一片区域，使其中的隐身单位现形，并减速%movespeed%%%，区域持续%duration%秒。现形的单位受到%damage%点伤害。 负面状态会在敌方英雄离开该范围后额外粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
active: Reveal：For 12 seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by -20% in a 1050 radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take 25 damage. The debuff effect on enemies lingers for 8s after leaving the area of effect.

name: 树之祭祀
description: 使用：吞食 吃掉一棵树，获得%health_regen%点/秒生命恢复，持续%buff_duration%秒。食用铁树枝干种下的小树后恢复时间加倍。 可以使用%tooltip_charges%次。对友方英雄使用可以分给他一次使用机会。 吞食树木施法距离：%abilitycastrange%
active: Devour：Consumes a target tree to gain 7 health regeneration for 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration. Comes with 3 charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango. Tree Range: 165

name: 治疗药膏
description: 使用：药膏 向目标提供%health_regen%点/秒生命恢复，持续%buff_duration%秒。 受到敌方英雄或肉山攻击时效果会被驱散。 对友军施放时每秒治疗量减半。
active: Salve：Grants 30 health regeneration to the target for 13 seconds. If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost. Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.

name: 回城卷轴
description: 使用：传送 经过%tooltip_channel_time%秒持续施法后传送到指定的友方建筑。 双击将直接传送至己方泉水。
active: Teleport：After channeling for 3 seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.

name: 飞行信使
description: Flying Courier

name: 奶酪
description: 使用：干酪 立刻回复%health_restore%点生命与%mana_restore%点魔法。
active: Fondue：Instantly restores 2500 health and 1500 mana.

name: 刷新球碎片
description: 主动：完全重置 重置所有技能的冷却时间。与刷新球共享冷却时间。这件物品只会在英雄的主物品栏中进行冷却。
active: Reset Cooldowns：Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

name: 银月之晶
description: 使用：吞噬 吞噬银月之晶，永久获得%consumed_bonus%攻击速度和%consumed_bonus_night_vision%夜间视野加成。最多使用1次。 被动：月夜之视 提供额外夜间视野。
active: Consume：Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain 60 attack speed and 200 bonus night vision. Max 1 use.
passive: Shade Sight：Grants bonus night vision.

name: 先锋盾
description: 被动：伤害格挡 拥有%block_chance%%%几率格挡伤害，近战英雄可格挡%block_damage_melee%点伤害，远程英雄可格挡%block_damage_ranged%点。
passive: Damage Block：Grants a 60% chance to block 50 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 25 damage on ranged.

name: 魔龙枪
description: The forward charge of the wyvern host grants no quarter.

name: 疯狂面具
description: 主动：狂热 攻击速度提升%berserk_bonus_attack_speed%，移动速度提升%berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%%/%berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%%（远程/近战），减速抗性提升%berserk_slow_resist%%%，但是护甲降低%berserk_armor_reduction%点，并且被沉默。持续%berserk_duration%秒。 被动：吸血 攻击者每次攻击都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。
active: Berserk：Gives 100 attack speed, 8% / 12% movement speed (ranged/melee), and 30% slow resistance, but reduces your armor by 7 and silences you. Lasts 6 seconds.
passive: Lifesteal：Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

name: 水晶剑
description: 被动：致命一击 每次攻击时有%crit_chance%%%概率造成%crit_multiplier%%%伤害。
passive: Critical Strike：Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 160% damage.

name: 慧光
description: Kaya

name: 散华
description: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.

name: 夜叉
description: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.

name: 刃甲
description: 主动：伤害反弹 %duration%秒内会反弹所有来源的伤害，百分比提升%active_reflection_pct%%%。 被动：伤害反弹 每次受到攻击时，反弹%passive_reflection_constant% + 所受攻击伤害的%passive_reflection_pct%%%。
active: Damage Return：For 5.5 seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by 85%.
passive: Damage Return：Everytime you are attacked, you return 10 damage plus 15% of the attack damage dealt to you.

name: 莫尔迪基安的臂章
description: 开关：邪恶之力 开启后邪恶之力将提供+%unholy_bonus_damage%点攻击力、+%unholy_bonus_strength%点力量和+%unholy_bonus_armor%点护甲，但每秒失去%unholy_health_drain_per_second%点生命值。 开启邪恶之力后生命流失并不会导致死亡，关闭邪恶之力后力量降低也不会导致死亡。
active: Unholy Strength：When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second. You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.

name: 净魂之刃
description: 主动：阻止 以敌方单位为目标，减缓其移动速度，持续%purge_slow_duration%秒。 被动：破法 每次攻击将燃烧目标%feedback_mana_burn%点魔法，而且每燃烧一点魔法都会造成%damage_per_burn%点物理伤害。 幻象不会燃烧魔法。
active: Inhibit：Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.
passive: Manabreak：Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. Illusions do not burn mana.

name: 支配头盔
description: 主动：支配 控制一个普通、非远古单位，其移动速度变为%speed_base%。被支配单位的最大生命值将不会少于%health_min%点。另外还将使该单位+%creep_bonus_damage%点基础攻击力，+%creep_bonus_hp_regen%点/秒生命恢复，+%creep_bonus_mp_regen%点/秒魔法恢复和+%creep_bonus_armor%点护甲。 被支配单位的最大生命值大于%health_min%点时将保留原来的最大生命值。施法者会获得被支配单位%bounty_pct%%%的原击杀金钱和经验。被支配单位的击杀奖励为固定%bounty_gold%金，并且不会被秒杀非英雄单位的技能直接击杀。 被支配单位受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后%creep_damage_taken_cooldown%秒内无法使用支配技能。
active: Dominate：Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to 370 and max health to a minimum of 1000. Also provides the unit with +25 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen and +4 armor. Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1000 retain their original max health. Grants the caster 50% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 100 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise. The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

name: 圣化护服
description: 被动：神圣化 每%AbilityChargeRestoreTime%秒获得一点能量，最多为%AbilityCharges%点。获得一点能量时，移动速度提升%movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%%，持续%duration%秒。 只要受到来自玩家控制单位或肉山的伤害，所有能量都会被消耗，并获得全伤害护盾，持续%duration%秒，每点能量可以吸收%barrier_per_stack%点伤害（最高为%max_barrier_tooltip%点）。
passive: Hallowed：Gain a stack every 3s, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Upon gaining a stack, your movement speed is increased by 20% for 7s. Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled unit or Roshan, consume all stacks to gain an all damage barrier for 7s that absorbs 120 damage per stack (360 max).

name: 回音战刃
description: 被动：回音一击 近战攻击可以快速攻击两次。两次攻击都将减缓%movement_slow%%%移动速度，第一次持续%slow_duration%秒。
passive: Echo Strike：Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 0.8 seconds on the first strike.

name: 陨星锤
description: 主动：陨星锤 持续施法 - 成功施法后召唤一颗陨石，打击%impact_radius%范围内敌人，造成%stun_duration%秒眩晕和冲击伤害。对敌方单位和建筑造成持续伤害，持续%burn_duration%秒。非建筑单位在烧灼期间还会被减速%burn_slow%%%。 对建筑冲击伤害：%impact_damage_buildings% 对建筑持续伤害：%burn_dps_buildings% 对非建筑冲击伤害：%impact_damage_units% 对非建筑持续伤害：%burn_dps_units% 持续施法时间：%max_duration%秒 落地时间：%land_time%秒
active: Meteor Hammer：CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a 400 AoE, stunning enemies for 0.75 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for 6 seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for 20% for the duration of the burn. Building Impact Damage: 90 Building Over Time Damage: 50 Non-Building Impact Damage: 130 Non-Building Over Time Damage: 50 Channel Duration: 2 seconds. Landing Time: 0.5 seconds.

name: 碎颅锤
description: 被动：重击 近战英雄的攻击有%bash_chance_melee%%%的概率击晕目标%bash_duration%秒并额外造成%bonus_chance_damage%点物理伤害。远程英雄的击晕概率为%bash_chance_ranged%%%。
passive: Bash：Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.

name: 漩涡
description: 被动：连环闪电 攻击有%chain_chance%%%几率释放一道连环闪电，在%chain_radius%范围内%chain_strikes%个目标之间跳跃，闪电将造成%chain_damage%点魔法伤害。触发闪电时无视闪避。
passive: Chain Lightning：Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

name: 永恒之盘
description: 被动：强断连招 当受到伤害并且生命值低于%health_threshold_pct%%%时，会对英雄施加强驱散效果，并且获得%buff_duration%秒的加成状态，提供+%status_resistance%%%状态抗性，并且所有受到和造成的伤害全部归零。只有来自玩家的伤害才会触发。每次触发后冷却时间都会增加。 驱散类型： 强驱散
passive: Combo Breaker：When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

name: 振魂石
description: Regain lost courage.

name: 影刃
description: 主动：疾影步 进入隐身状态，持续%windwalk_duration%秒。直到持续时间结束、攻击或施法。当激活疾影步时，移动速度提升%windwalk_movement_speed%%%并能穿越单位。 破隐一击造成%windwalk_bonus_damage%点额外物理伤害。
active: Shadow Walk：Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move 20% faster and can move through units. If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.

name: 天堂之戟
description: 主动：缴械 阻止目标在%disarm_melee%秒内进行攻击。
active: Disarm：Prevents a target from attacking for 3.5 seconds.

name: 黯灭
description: 被动：毁蚀 物理攻击将降低目标%corruption_armor%点护甲，持续%corruption_duration%秒。 被动：灵魂窃取 黯灭在装备后每次有英雄死于毁蚀效果下就会+%bonus_damage_per_kill%点攻击力，最高为%max_damage%点。
passive: Soul Stealer：Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.

name: 赤红甲
description: 主动：坚盾 使周围所有友方英雄和建筑每次受到物理攻击都有%block_chance_active%%%几率格挡伤害，数值为%block_damage_active% + %max_hp_pct%%%施法者最大生命值。持续%duration%秒。 作用范围：%bonus_aoe_radius% 被动：伤害格挡 近战英雄每次受到攻击都有%block_chance%%%几率格挡%block_damage_melee%点伤害，远程英雄则是格挡%block_damage_ranged%点。
active: Guard：For 7 seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a 100% chance to block damage equal to 70 plus 2% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack. Radius: 1200
passive: Damage Block：Grants a 60% chance to block 75 damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and 50 damage on ranged.

name: 清莲宝珠
description: 主动：回音之壳 对目标单位施加一个外壳，持续%active_duration%秒，可以将大部分指向性技能反馈给施法者。 拥有外壳的单位依然会受到技能的伤害。 驱散类型： 弱驱散
active: Echo Shell：Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster. The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

name: 永世法衣
description: 被动：法衣 受到敌人的技能伤害在减免前的%mana_restore_pct%%%会转化为自身的魔法。 被动：永世耐力 装备的英雄每受到%stack_threshold%点技能伤害，就会获得一层持续%stack_duration%秒的叠加效果，最多为%max_stacks%层。每层效果会使永世法衣的魔法抗性提升%stack_resist%%%。
passive: Eternal Endurance：For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .

name: 狂战斧
description: 主动：砍伐 砍伐一根指定树木。 被动：压制 对非英雄单位进行物理攻击会造成额外伤害，近战英雄为%quelling_bonus%点，远程英雄为%quelling_bonus_ranged%点。 被动：分裂 普通攻击时对目标周围最远%cleave_distance%距离的锥形区域内敌人造成%cleave_damage_percent%%%物理伤害。对非英雄单位造成%cleave_damage_percent_creep%%%物理伤害。（仅近战有效）
active: Chop Tree：Destroy a target tree.
passive: Cleave：Deals 60% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to 650 around the target. Deals 40% against creeps. (Melee Only)

name: 黑皇杖
description: 主动：天神下凡 施加弱驱散。获得减益免疫状态。提供%spell_reduce%%%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。 持续时间：%duration%秒 驱散类型： 弱驱散
active: Avatar：Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. Duration: 9s Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

name: 散夜对剑
description: Sange and Yasha, when attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.

name: 散慧对剑
description: Two of three known items of unimaginable power that many believe were crafted at the same enchanter's forge.

name: 慧夜对剑
description: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.

name: 否决坠饰
description: 主动：否决 驱散目标身上的效果，并且施加负面效果，持续%mute_duration%秒。期间持续驱散和减速目标。 驱散类型： 弱驱散
active: Nullify：Dispels the target and applies a debuff for 4 seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

name: 飓风长戟
description: 主动：飓风之力 将自己和敌方目标朝相反方向各推开%enemy_length%距离，并且接下来对目标的%max_attacks%次攻击将不受英雄攻击距离的限制，同时获得+%bonus_attack_speed%攻击速度，持续%range_duration%秒。 对自身或友军使用，向面对方向推进%push_length%距离。 对敌军施法距离：%cast_range_enemy%
active: Hurricane Thrust：Pushes you and target enemy 425 units away from each other, and for 6 seconds, allows you to make 5 attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +100 attack speed. Can be cast on self or allies to push the target 600 units in the direction it is facing. Enemy Range: 425

name: 希瓦的守护
description: 主动：极寒冲击 发出一道寒冷的波动，对敌人造成%blast_damage%点魔法伤害并减速%blast_movement_speed%%%，持续%blast_debuff_duration%秒。 作用范围：%blast_radius% 被动：霜冷光环 降低所有敌人%aura_attack_speed%攻击速度。 作用范围：%aura_radius%
active: Arctic Blast：Emits a freezing wave that deals 260 magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by -40% for 4 seconds. Radius: 825
passive: Freezing Aura：Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by -45. Radius: 1200

name: 幻影斧
description: 主动：镜像 制造%images_count%个你的幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。 近战英雄的幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%%的攻击力，远程英雄的幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%的攻击力。幻象承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%的伤害。 驱散类型： 弱驱散
active: Mirror Image：Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 28%. Illusions take 300% damage. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

name: 缚灵索
description: 主动：永恒锁链 缠绕目标%radius_tooltip%范围内所有敌人，持续%duration%秒。
active: Eternal Chains：Roots all enemies in a 350 radius for 2 seconds.

name: 血精石
description: 主动：血之契约 血精石的技能吸血效果提升至%spell_lifesteal_while_active%%%。持续%buff_duration%秒。 被动：法术虚弱光环 敌方单位承受的技能伤害增加%aura_spell_vulnerability%%%。 作用范围：%aura_radius%
active: Bloodpact：Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds.
passive: Spell Weakness Aura：Enemy units take 12% increased damage from spells. Radius: 1200

name: 辉耀
description: 开关：辉耀灼烧 开启后，辉耀灼烧每秒对敌军造成%aura_damage%点魔法伤害。幻象每秒造成%aura_damage_illusions%点魔法伤害。 作用范围：%aura_radius%
active: Burn：When active, scorches enemies for 60 magical damage per second. Illusions deal 35 magical damage per second. Radius: 650

name: 林肯法球
description: 被动：法术抵抗 每%block_cooldown%秒被动抵挡一次大部分指向性技能。 主动：抵抗转移 将抵挡状态暂时转移给一个友方单位，持续%block_cooldown%秒。
active: Transfer Spellblock：Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for 14 seconds.
passive: Spellblock：Blocks most targeted spells once every 14 seconds.

name: 克莱拉牧杖
description: 主动：鲁姆斯克仪式 进入鬼魂形态，持续%duration%秒，对物理伤害免疫，但是无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%extra_spell_damage_percent%%%。 每秒从%active_radius%范围内的敌方英雄窃取%movespeed_steal_pct%%%移动速度。移动速度的窃取效果持续%stack_duration%秒。 腐化光环效果提升至%active_health_steal%%%。每秒所有减少的生命回复都会转移到身上。 被动：腐化光环 附近敌方英雄的生命回复减少%health_steal%%%。 作用范围：%radius%
active: Rite of Rumusque：You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage. Steal 5% movement speed from enemy heroes in 900 range every second. Movement speed steal lasts 1.5s. Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to 75%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.
passive: Putrefaction Aura：Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by 30%. Radius: 900

name: 金箍棒
description: 被动：穿刺 每次攻击均有%bonus_chance%%%几率无视闪避，并造成额外%bonus_chance_damage%点魔法伤害。
passive: Pierce：Grants each attack a 80% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 70 bonus magical damage.

name: 撒旦之邪力
description: 主动：不洁狂热 吸血效果提升至%unholy_lifesteal_total_tooltip%%%，持续%unholy_duration%秒。 驱散类型： 弱驱散 被动：吸血 攻击者每次攻击都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。
active: Unholy Rage：Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
passive: Lifesteal：Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

name: 恐鳌之心
description: 被动：巨兽之血 生命恢复提升缺失生命值的%missing_health_regen%%%。
passive: Behemoth's Blood：Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.

name: 代达罗斯之殇
description: 被动：致命一击 普通攻击有%crit_chance%%%几率造成%crit_multiplier%%%伤害。
passive: Critical Strike：Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal 225% damage.

name: 强袭胸甲
description: 被动：强袭光环 附近友军单位和建筑提升%aura_attack_speed%攻击速度和%aura_positive_armor%点护甲，削弱附近敌军%aura_negative_armor%点护甲。 作用范围：%aura_radius%
passive: Assault Aura：Grants 30 attack speed and 5 armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by -5. Radius: 1200

name: 虚灵之刃
description: 主动：虚化冲击 发射一道能量波，将目标转变为虚无状态，接下来受到的魔法伤害将会提升%ethereal_damage_bonus%%%，并且无法攻击或被攻击。 如果目标是敌人还将被减速%blast_movement_slow%%%，并额外受到%blast_stat_multiplier%x[自身属性总和]+%blast_damage_base%点魔法伤害。 持续时间：%duration%秒
active: Ether Blast：Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemy targets are also slowed by -80%, and take 1x the sum of all your attributes + 50 as magical damage. Duration: 4 seconds

name: 蝴蝶
description: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

name: 雷神之锤
description: 主动：静电冲击 对目标单位施加一个静电护盾，持续%static_duration%秒。护盾有%static_chance%%%几率对附近攻击护盾的目标及其周围%static_strikes%个敌方单位释放闪电冲击，造成%static_damage%点魔法伤害。 被动：连环闪电 攻击有%chain_chance%%%几率释放一道连环闪电，在%chain_radius%范围内%chain_strikes%个目标之间跳跃，每次造成%chain_damage%点魔法伤害。触发闪电时无视闪避。
active: Static Charge：Places a charged shield on a target unit for 15 seconds which has a 20% chance to release a 225 magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and 4 additional enemies.
passive: Chain Lightning：Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 12 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 180 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

name: 圣剑
description: 切换：转变 在%bonus_spell_amp%%%技能增强加成和%bonus_damage%攻击力加成之间切换。 被动：永恒 死亡后掉落，而且无法被摧毁。 当拥有者的队友拾取后，仅在返还给拥有者后才会有效。一旦被敌人拾取，圣剑将不再受此限制，信使无法拾取掉落的圣剑。
active: Transmute：Toggle to gain either 25% bonus spell amplification or 250 bonus attack damage.
passive: Everlasting：Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed. Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.

name: 统御头盔
description: 主动：支配 控制一个中立单位，其移动速度变为%speed_base%。被支配单位的最大生命值将不会少于%health_min%点。另外还将使该单位+%creep_bonus_damage%点基础攻击力，+%creep_bonus_hp_regen%点/秒生命恢复，+%creep_bonus_mp_regen%点/秒魔法恢复，+%creep_bonus_armor%点护甲并且目标的部分技能等级提升1级。 被支配单位的最大生命值大于%health_min%点时将保留原来的最大生命值。施法者会获得被支配单位的原击杀金钱和经验。被支配单位的击杀奖励为固定%bounty_gold%金，并且不会被秒杀非英雄单位的技能直接击杀。 被支配单位受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后%creep_damage_taken_cooldown%秒内无法使用支配技能。
active: Dominate：Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1800. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level. Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1800 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise. The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

name: 白银之锋
description: 主动：疾影步 进入隐身直到%windwalk_duration%秒持续时间结束、或者在此之前攻击或施法。隐身时，移动速度将提升%windwalk_movement_speed%%%，而且可以穿越单位。 破隐一击将额外造成%windwalk_bonus_damage%点物理伤害，同时%backstab_duration%秒内目标的被动技能无效，移动速度不会超过%max_movement_speed%。
active: Shadow Walk：Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you move 25% faster and can move through units. Attacking to end the invisibility will deal 300 bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for 5 seconds, and cap their movement speed to 200.

name: 斯嘉蒂之眼
description: 被动：霜冻攻击 攻击对敌方远程目标会减缓%cold_slow_ranged%%%移动速度，对敌方近战目标会减缓%cold_slow_melee%%%移动速度。攻击还会降低敌人%cold_attack_slow_melee%%%攻击速度和%restoration_reduction%%%生命回复。持续%cold_duration%秒。
passive: Cold Attack：Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -20% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

name: 散魂剑
description: 主动：抑制 同时驱散佩戴者和目标。敌方目标会被减速%enemy_effect_duration%秒，友方目标则会提升移动速度和%slow_resist%%%减速抗性，持续%ally_effect_duration%秒。施法者总是会获得友军的加成效果。 移动速度减缓和提升效果在状态持续时间内初始均为%phase_movement_speed%%%，并且逐渐减少至0。 驱散类型： 弱驱散 被动：破法 每次攻击将燃烧目标%feedback_mana_burn%点魔法，而且每燃烧一点魔法都会造成%damage_per_burn%点物理伤害。 幻象不会燃烧魔法。
active: Suppress：Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 5 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 5 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast. Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration. Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
passive: Manabreak：Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. Illusions do not burn mana.

name: 深渊之刃
description: 主动：强击 击晕一个敌方目标，持续%stun_duration%秒。 无视减益免疫。 被动：重击 近战英雄攻击时有%bash_chance_melee%%%的概率击晕目标%bash_duration%秒，并额外造成%bonus_chance_damage%点物理伤害。远程英雄的击晕概率为%bash_chance_ranged%%%。
active: Overwhelm：Stuns a target enemy unit for 1.6 seconds. Pierces Debuff Immunity.
passive: Bash：Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 120 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.

name: 血棘
description: 主动：灵魂撕裂 使目标沉默%silence_duration%秒，沉默结束后其间所受伤害的%silence_damage_percent%%%将以额外魔法伤害的形式结算。 英雄/非英雄对目标发动攻击会分别额外造成%proc_damage_heroes% / %proc_damage_creeps%点伤害。另外，自身和控制单位对目标发动的所有攻击都拥有克敌机先效果。 被动：穿刺 每次攻击有%proc_chance%%%几率无视闪避并造成额外%passive_proc_damage%点魔法伤害。
active: Soul Rend：Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 60% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage. All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to 50 if the attacker is a hero, and 25, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.
passive: Pierce：Grants each attack a 40% chance to pierce through evasion and deal 60 bonus magical damage.

name: 魔杖
description: 主动：充能 立刻根据能量点数回复相应的生命和魔法，每点能量恢复%restore_per_charge%点生命和魔法。 每当附近%charge_radius%范围内有可见敌人施放技能都会自动充能（最多%max_charges%点能量）。
active: Energy Charge：Instantly restores 15 health and mana per charge stored. Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

name: 怨灵系带
description: A circlet with faint whispers echoing about it.

name: 空灵挂件
description: A small gemstone attached to several chains.

name: 护腕
description: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.

name: 魔瓶
description: 使用：恢复 每次使用都能在%restore_time%秒内恢复%health_restore%点生命与%mana_restore%点魔法。受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击会失去恢复效果。 魔瓶在靠近友方泉水时会被灌满。 按住Ctrl键可以对友军施放。 被动：储存神符 右键点击神符可以将其存入魔瓶内留作备用，90秒后神符未被使用将会自动激活。 使用储存的神符后魔瓶将会被灌满。
active: Regenerate：Consumes a charge to restore 110 health and 60 mana over 2.7 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost. The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain. Hold Control to use on an allied hero.
passive: Store Rune：Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds. Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.

name: 灵魂之戒
description: 主动：献身 消耗%AbilityHealthCost%点生命值来暂时获取%mana_gain%点魔法值。持续%duration%秒。 如果获得魔法后超过了自身的魔法上限，多出来的魔法会加入上限，并优先被使用。
active: Sacrifice：Consume %abilityhealthcost% health to temporarily gain 170 mana. Lasts 10 seconds. If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.

name: 丰饶之环
description: A source of spiritual and physical nourishment.

name: 动力鞋
description: 主动：属性切换 将附加属性在力量，敏捷以及智力三者间切换，选择+%bonus_stat%点力量，+%bonus_stat%点敏捷或+%bonus_stat%点智力。 多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
active: Switch Attribute：Switches between +10 Strength, +10 Agility, or +10 Intelligence.

name: 坚韧球
description: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.

name: 相位鞋
description: 主动：相位移动 提升移动速度并使你可以穿越单位，转身也更快，持续%phase_duration%秒。近战英雄提升%phase_movement_speed%%%移动速度，远程英雄提升%phase_movement_speed_range%%%移动速度。 多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
active: Phase：Gives 20% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and 10% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for 3 seconds.

name: 空明杖
description: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary staff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.

name: 迈达斯之手
description: 主动：炼金 立刻炼化一个普通单位，获得%bonus_gold%金钱。对中立生物使用时，在允许的情况下会掉落一包狂石。 无法用于远古单位。
active: Transmute：Kills a non-hero target for 160 gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle. Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.

name: 远行鞋
description: 升级：回城卷轴 使回城卷轴升级。可以对单位使用，降低冷却时间，并且使用时不会消耗次数。 多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
active: Town Portal Scroll：Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.

name: 灵匣
description: 被动：法术强化 下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成%bonus_spell_damage%点额外伤害，并且减缓%slow%%%移动速度，持续%slow_duration%秒。
passive: Empower Spell：The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 150 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 30% for 3s.

name: 巫师之刃
description: 被动：巫师之刃 使下次攻击施加毒素，持续%slow_duration%秒，减缓%slow%%%移动速度，并且每秒造成%int_damage_multiplier%倍智力值的伤害。本次攻击具有克敌机先效果。
passive: Witch Blade：Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.

name: 远行鞋
description: 升级：回城卷轴 使回城卷轴升级。可以对单位和英雄使用，降低冷却时间，持续施法时间，并且使用时不会消耗次数。 多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
active: Town Portal Scroll：Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.

name: 绝刃
description: 被动：法术强化 下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成%bonus_spell_damage%点额外伤害，禁用其被动技能，并且减缓%slow%%%移动速度，持续%slow_duration%秒。
passive: Empower Spell：The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.
